john.sheet.onlyVoter: Only {name} can vote, so a photo settles it. Add one before the vote {closes}. With no photo the tick is struck, and you get 12 more hours to do it.
john.sheet.answered: Your photo is on the John for the house to see.
john.sheet.coverOfYours: {name} covered this. The rest of the house checks it, not you.
john.sheet.answerPhoto: Add a photo of it done
john.sheet.undoLate: It’s past its due time, so it’s overdue as soon as it’s undone, and ticking it again counts as late.
john.sheet.undoLateCost: It’s past its due time, so it’s overdue as soon as it’s undone, and ticking it again counts as late: {late}.
john.sheet.voted: Vote counted. You can change it on Week.
john.sheet.excused: {who} used a skip on it, so there’s no forfeit.
john.sheet.coverPhoto: Take a photo: I did this
john.sheet.coverBody: {owner} hasn’t done it. If you do, it counts as {owner}’s miss, and you get {points}.
john.sheet.coverBodyMoney: {owner} hasn’t done it. If you do, it counts as {owner}’s miss, and you get {points} and {money}.
john.sheet.coverSoon: It’s still {owner}’s to do. Anyone else can cover it from {when}.
john.sheet.coverHeld: {owner} is on it. Anyone else can cover it from {when}.
john.sheet.held: You’re on it. Covers wait until {when}.
john.sheet.coveredSettled: {who} did it for {owner}, so it counts as {whose} miss.
john.sheet.coveredSettledWhen: {who} did it for {owner} {when}, so it counts as {whose} miss.

john.crew.hint: Effort is per person. Whoever does it shares the points, helpers included.
john.crew.title: Who did it?
john.crew.noMoreHelpers: Everyone here is already on it.
john.crew.photoDone: Take a photo and mark done
john.crew.missedAbsent: Left off the roll call, so it’s a miss.
john.crew.coverBody: {owners} haven’t done it. If you do, it counts as a miss for each of them, and you get {points}.
john.crew.coverBodyMoney: {owners} haven’t done it. If you do, it counts as a miss for each of them, and you get {points} and {money}.

john.crew.pushAddedBody: It counts as your work. If you didn’t help, say so on the John.
john.crew.pushLeftOffBody: That counts as a miss for you. If you were there, dispute it on the John.
john.why.label: Why?
john.why.only: {you, select, true {{who} were the only one sharing it who’s home that day.} other {{who} was the only one sharing it who’s home that day.}}
john.why.behind: It goes to whoever is furthest behind their fair share. When it was dealt, that was {who}.
john.why.fewer: It was level on fair shares, so it went to whoever had fewer Johns this week: {who}.
john.why.draw: It was level on fair shares and on Johns this week, so it was drawn: {who}.
john.why.flag: A flag goes to whoever is on call this week, or, if they’re away, to whoever at home has been handed least.
john.why.nudged: It goes to whoever is furthest behind their fair share, with a small nudge away from whoever did it last time, so Johns move round. That made it {who}.
john.why.movedOn: {one, select, true {{level, select, true {{names} was level, but did it last time.} other {{names} was further behind, but did it last time.}}} other {{level, select, true {{names} were level, but did it last time.} other {{names} were further behind, but did it last time.}}}}
john.why.full: {one, select, true {{names} was further behind, but had already been handed half a week extra, the most one week catches up.} other {{names} were further behind, but had already been handed half a week extra, the most one week catches up.}}
john.why.again: {you, select, true {{who} did it last time too, but were still furthest behind.} other {{who} did it last time too, but was still furthest behind.}}
john.why.away: {one, select, true {{names} is away that day.} other {{names} are away that day.}}
john.why.moved: It was dealt to {dealtTo}, and came to {holder} in a swap or while they were away.
john.why.unknown: This one was dealt before Jonz kept its working.
john.why.back: {you, select, true {You missed it last time, so it came back to you. A miss counts for nobody.} other {{who} missed it last time, so it came back to them. A miss counts for nobody.}}
john.why.oneEach: Everyone home gets one John of their own before anyone gets a second, and whoever is furthest behind picks first. This one is {whose}.
john.why.mostRoom: It went to whoever had the most of this week’s budget left: {who}.
john.why.turn: The house takes turns in order, and this week it’s {whose} turn.
john.why.nextInLine: Whoever’s turn it was is away or has a full week, so the next in line does it: {who}. Whoever was skipped stays first in line.
john.why.waited: {weeks, plural, one {It waited a week for room in someone’s budget first.} other {It waited # weeks for room in someone’s budget first.}}
john.why.stretched: Nobody else had room, but it had already waited a week, so it went a little over {whose} budget rather than wait again.
john.why.againWaited: It had waited two weeks, so it went back to whoever did it last time rather than wait again.
john.why.movedTaken: {you, select, true {It’s on another day than usual because {who} already have a John on its own day.} other {It’s on another day than usual because {who} already has a John on its own day.}}
john.why.movedSuits: It’s on a day that suits {who} better.
john.why.movedAway: {you, select, true {It’s on another day than usual because {who} are away on its own day.} other {It’s on another day than usual because {who} is away on its own day.}}
john.why.movedGone: It’s on another day than usual because the week was dealt after its own day.
john.why.key: Work done over recent weeks against each share, with this week’s Johns dealt before it. Below zero is behind.
john.why.keyBudget: Work done against the house’s average, and how much of this week’s budget each had left before it. Below zero is behind.
john.why.keyTurns: Who was next in line for this John, among those home.
john.why.inLine: {place, selectordinal, one {#st in line} two {#nd in line} few {#rd in line} other {#th in line}}
john.why.missedBy: If it isn’t done by {when}, it’s missed. A miss counts for nobody, so the work comes back to {holder} in the next deals.
john.why.coverFrom: From {when} someone else can cover it, and then it counts as their work.
john.why.coverNow: Someone else can cover it now, and then it counts as their work.
john.why.coveredCounts: {who} covered it, so it counts as {whose} work.
john.why.missedCounts: It was missed, so it counts for nobody: the work comes back to {holder} in the next deals.
john.why.excusedCounts: It was skipped, so it counts for nobody: it comes out of everyone’s share this week.
